_lisez_moi: Couches A2-C1 de la scene « untersuchung » en anglais, ECRITES pour l'anglais sur les faits de l'image (memes zones f et reperes r que l'allemand). SOURCE : on corrige ici, puis python anglais/outils/scenes.py. Le champ _de rappelle le fait allemand ; scenes.py ne le copie pas.

A2.titre: Where is it? — les prépositions de lieu

qs.q: Where is the scale?
qs.phrase: The scale is against the wall.
qs.sens: La balance est contre le mur.
qs._de: Wo steht die Waage? → an der Wand

qs.q: The doctor is ___ the patient.
qs.phrase: The doctor is next to the patient.
qs.sens: La médecin est debout à côté du patient.
qs._de: Wo steht die Ärztin? → neben dem Patienten

qs.q: Where is Mark?
qs.phrase: Mark is in front of the scale.
qs.sens: Mark est debout devant la balance.
qs.n: in front of = devant. Attention : front seul n'est pas une préposition.
qs._de: Wo steht Mark? → vor der Waage

qs.q: The stethoscope is ___ his chest.
qs.phrase: The stethoscope is on his chest.
qs.sens: La médecin tient le stéthoscope sur sa poitrine.
qs.n: on = sur, posé ou accroché (on the table, on the wall).
qs._de: Wo hält die Ärztin das Stethoskop? → auf seiner Brust

qs.q: Where are the hands?
qs.phrase: The hands are by his thighs.
qs.sens: Ses mains sont le long de ses cuisses.
qs.n: by = près de, au bord de (by the window).
qs._de: Wo sind seine Hände? → an seinen Oberschenkeln

qs.q: The feet are ___ the floor.
qs.phrase: The feet are on the floor.
qs.sens: Ses pieds sont sur le sol.
qs.n: on = sur, posé ou accroché (on the table, on the wall).
qs._de: Wo sind seine Füße? → auf dem Boden

qs.q: The doctor is listening ___ his lungs.
qs.phrase: The doctor is listening to his lungs.
qs.sens: La médecin ausculte ses poumons.

qs.q: Please take a deep ___!
qs.phrase: Please take a deep breath!
qs.sens: Inspirez profondément, s'il vous plaît !

qs.q: Mark has undressed down ___ his underwear.
qs.phrase: Mark has undressed down to his underwear.
qs.sens: Mark s'est déshabillé jusqu'au caleçon.

qs.q: The doctor puts the stethoscope ___ his chest.
qs.phrase: The doctor puts the stethoscope on his chest.
qs.sens: La médecin pose le stéthoscope sur sa poitrine.

qs.q: Mark ___ step on the scale in a minute.
qs.phrase: Mark will step on the scale in a minute.
qs.sens: Mark va monter sur la balance dans une minute.

qs.q: Then he stands ___ on the scale.
qs.phrase: Then he stands still on the scale.
qs.sens: Ensuite, il reste immobile sur la balance.

qs.q: His lungs are being ___.
qs.phrase: His lungs are being listened to.
qs.sens: On est en train d'ausculter ses poumons.
qs.n: Le passif garde la préposition : listened to.

qs.q: The patient ___ chest is being examined is Mark.
qs.phrase: The patient whose chest is being examined is Mark.
qs.sens: Le patient dont on ausculte la poitrine s'appelle Mark.

qs.q: The doctor ___ is examining him is his family doctor.
qs.phrase: The doctor who is examining him is his family doctor.
qs.sens: La médecin qui l'examine est sa médecin de famille.

qs.q: The scale ___ he's going to step on is against the wall.
qs.phrase: The scale that he's going to step on is against the wall.
qs.sens: La balance sur laquelle il va monter est contre le mur.

qs.q: In a minute, his height will also ___ measured.
qs.phrase: In a minute, his height will also be measured.
qs.sens: Dans un instant, on mesurera aussi sa taille.

qs.q: Mark keeps still ___ he's being examined.
qs.phrase: Mark keeps still while he's being examined.
qs.sens: Mark reste tranquille pendant qu'on l'examine.

qs.q: He ___ do a lot of sports.
qs.phrase: He must do a lot of sports.
qs.sens: Il doit faire beaucoup de sport.

qs.q: He's ___ in good health.
qs.phrase: He's probably in good health.
qs.sens: Il est sans doute en bonne santé.

qs.q: This doctor is said ___ very thorough.
qs.phrase: This doctor is said to be very thorough.
qs.sens: Il paraît que cette médecin est très minutieuse.

qs.q: If his heartbeat were irregular, she ___ send him to a cardiologist.
qs.phrase: If his heartbeat were irregular, she would send him to a cardiologist.
qs.sens: Si son rythme cardiaque était irrégulier, elle l'enverrait chez le cardiologue.

qs.q: If he hadn't undressed, she ___ have been able to examine him.
qs.phrase: If he hadn't undressed, she wouldn't have been able to examine him.
qs.sens: S'il ne s'était pas déshabillé, elle n'aurait pas pu l'ausculter.

qs.q: Without an exam, nobody ___ know for sure.
qs.phrase: Without an exam, nobody could know for sure.
qs.sens: Sans examen, on ne pourrait pas le savoir exactement.
